context: A uni student catches up with his old teacher about the new academic year
purpose: Teach: 月曜日/火曜日/三月/校長/分間/半ば/長男/国語

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、お久しぶりです。三月の卒業式以来ですね。
lines.en: Teacher, it's been a while. Since the March graduation ceremony, right?
lines.style: Warm reunion greeting with respectful tone toward former teacher

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本当に久しぶり。元気そうで何より。大学はもう慣れた?
lines.en: It really has been a while. Glad you look well. Have you settled into university?
lines.style: Affectionate teacher voice, casual but caring delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ようやくです。月曜日と火曜日が一番きつくて、朝から夕方までびっしりで。
lines.en: Just barely. Mondays and Tuesdays are the worst, packed from morning till evening.
lines.style: Slightly tired student tone, honest and conversational

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう、新学期の半ばまではみんなそう言うのよ。慣れれば大丈夫。
lines.en: Yes, everyone says that until midway through the new term. You'll adjust.
lines.style: Reassuring veteran teacher giving gentle encouragement

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうだといいんですけど。今は九十分間の講義が連続で、頭がパンクしそうです。
lines.en: I hope so. Right now ninety-minute lectures back-to-back, my head's about to burst.
lines.style: Earnest student venting mildly with a self-deprecating laugh

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、私も昔そうだった。ところでね、四月から校長先生に推薦されて、国語科の主任になったの。
lines.en: Haha, I was the same back then. By the way, since April I was recommended by the principal and became head of the Japanese department.
lines.style: Proud but humble teacher sharing personal news warmly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっ、すごいじゃないですか!おめでとうございます。先生の長男もそろそろ中学ですよね?
lines.en: Wow, that's amazing! Congratulations. Your eldest son must be starting middle school soon, right?
lines.style: Genuine surprise and excitement, then friendly follow-up question

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 覚えててくれたの、ありがとう。長男は今年からよ。バタバタだけど、また顔出してね。
lines.en: You remembered, thank you. My eldest started this year. It's hectic, but come visit again sometime.
lines.style: Touched grandmotherly warmth wrapped in casual closing
